_comment: Learning paths (docs/PATHS.md, D-034). Title lines say the path's title with its host's name; vary.host must list the CURRENT host's name (tests/unit/paths.test.ts), so swapping a library's host flags the clip to render. Ocean map and journey islands (D-041): ocean.*, island.*; island.friend's vary.name lists every character that can stand on an island as a friend.

path.view.hello.text: Here is your island! Tap the glowing stop to play.

path.view.end.text: You explored this whole path! Play again, or choose a new adventure.

path.offer.tired.text: Great playing! Want to try another path for a while? You can come back anytime.

path.offer.end.text: You explored this whole path! Want to try another one?

path.note.skip.text: Zoom! You're ready for a bigger challenge!

path.note.down.text: Great practice! Next time: a warm-up round!
